literal: Flower resembling eye-she preciousness not-knowing, gossip to-me gave this town.
translation: Without understanding how precious and difficult to attain my flower-eyed beloved is, this town has gifted me with public gossip.
modern: மலர் போன்ற கண்களை உடையவளின் அருமையை உணராமல், இந்த ஊரார் எங்களுக்கு அலரை (பழிச்சொல்லை) பரிசாகத் தந்துள்ளனர்.
explanation: In this couplet, the lover speaks about the rumors spreading in the town regarding his secret love. He notes that the townspeople do not comprehend the preciousness (அருமை) of his beloved, whose eyes are like flowers (மலரன்ன கண்ணாள்), nor do they understand how difficult she is to attain. Instead of being sympathetic, this town (இவ்வூர்) has simply gifted him with public gossip (அலர்). Though spoken with a touch of irony, this gossip ultimately aids the lover by bringing his secret love into the open, paving the way for marriage.
